claims.text: lobes keeps two promises it currently breaks: a targeted lobe operation touches only what it names, and a streamed or proxied answer is honest about what it is — every SSE relay ends with a terminal frame and a closed socket even when its upstream dies, and a proxied role advertises the hosting peer's own ready and context rather than a locally-guessed one.

compose_service_argv's up branch gains --no-deps: lobes/runtime/_compose.py:769-782 builds ['docker','compose',*files,'up','-d',*services] and its own docstring already promises 'only these are (re)started ... without disturbing the rest of the fleet' — grep for no-deps/no_deps across lobes/ returns nothing, so the docstring is the spec and the argv is the defect. lobes/cli/_commands/up.py:231 is the single caller and renders its dry-run PLAN from the same argv, so the printed plan becomes truthful in the same change.

the fleet template's gateway depends_on stops being an unconditional hard edge: lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml:1706-1710 lists vllm-primary/vllm-multimodal/vllm-embed/vllm-rerank, its own adjacent comment says 'Start order only — the gateway tolerates a backend still loading ... so it must not block on backend health', and lobes/cli/_commands/init.py:230 already !resets exactly this attribute for a role-dropping shape — so the edge is already known-droppable.

lobes gains a first-class gateway update path: lobes/cli/_commands/up.py:92 sets TARGETS = roles.ROLES + (colleague-stack,), so 'gateway' is not an addressable target and the operator need ('reinstall the gateway at a new MODEL_GEAR_VERSION, touch nothing else') has no verb — which is why issue 222 was hit through a hand-written docker compose up -d --build gateway.

_relay_streaming terminates the client stream on an upstream failure: lobes/gateway/server.py:3442-3457 loops resp.upstream.read(_CHUNK) -> wfile.write(frame_chunk(chunk)) with no try/except, so an exception from either side skips both CHUNK_TERMINATOR and any terminal SSE frame; _Upstream.read (server.py:482) is a bare http.client read1 that can raise OSError/HTTPException mid-stream.

a proxied role's advertised ready and context come from the hosting peer's own /capabilities, not from local data: lobes/roles.py:682-711 derives context from _served_context(role, env, native_context) over the LOCAL .env plus the catalog's native_max_model_len (1048576 for the Lightning entry), and lobes/gateway/_readiness.py:212-266 probe_peer_ready only checks that the peer's /v1/models lists served_name — which a box forwarding the alias (ASSOCIATE_SERVED_NAME) can never satisfy, yielding the reported ready:false/context:1048576 against the Orin's own ready:true/context:128000.

probe_audio_peer_ready (lobes/gateway/_readiness.py:322-341) is the existing precedent for reading a peer's GET /capabilities and trusting roles[role].ready — the core-role relay is that same shape widened to carry context, not a new mechanism.

the shape override contract is untouched: lobes/cli/_commands/init.py:187-231 renders docker-compose.shape.yml parking dropped services in the inert shape-dropped profile AND emitting 'depends_on: !reset null' on the gateway; tests/test_shape_goldens.py and tests/test_init_shape.py pin that text, so a base-template depends_on change must leave the override renderable and its goldens honest (a !reset of an absent attribute is legal but the comment prose around it would become false).

the stop branch of compose_service_argv stays as it is: docker compose stop does not walk depends_on, so --no-deps belongs on the up branch only — the issue itself names this asymmetry as why the defect went unnoticed.

the per-heavy-lobe depends_on edges are NOT in scope: vllm-muse (docker-compose.yml:1245), vllm-worker (:1354) and vllm-associate (:1602) each wait on vllm-embed/vllm-rerank service_healthy as a MEASURED mitigation for the Thor unified-memory first-boot race (2026-07-17, docs/machine-profiles.md) — only the gateway's edge is the defect.

issue 220 part 4 (bursts of 29x POST /tokenize 401 every ~2 min) is not fixed here: the issue itself states the fix is on the resident side (an older spark-colleague mesh resident without the gateway key), and nothing under lobes/gateway/ is misbehaving — a 401 on an unauthenticated POST is the #127 inbound gate working.

issue 220 part 3 (reranker calibration — distractors scoring 0.72-0.77, a NOTICE sentence out-ranking a toolbatch sentence) is not fixed here: it is a served-prompt-template/measurement investigation against Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B's model card, with no defect localised in lobes yet, and the reporter's own verdict is 'usable for top-k ordering, not thresholds'.

no live-box validation is claimed: the #108 rule in CLAUDE.md forbids doc, support-table or lobes capabilities output claiming validation without an acceptance transcript under docs/evidence/, and the boxes this was observed on (spark, the Thor peer, the Orin) are not being re-booted by this change — every claim here is offline-testable or stays UNVALIDATED.

open_vagueness.text: the reported symptom (client hangs, SSE socket ESTABLISHED, no terminal frame) is not fully explained by the traceback in the issue: a BrokenPipeError on wfile.write means the CLIENT already went away, yet the client reported still waiting — so there may be a second failure mode (the JSONDecodeError traceback, or a pre-relay path) that the _relay_streaming fix alone does not close.

whether an infeasible-but-PROXIED role should relay the peer's context verbatim or a min(local ceiling, peer context) — a caller that trusts a relayed 128000 is right today, but the value is the peer's, and this box cannot honour it if the proxy is later withdrawn.

scope_entries.finding: the up branch emits 'up -d <services>' with no --no-deps while its docstring promises fleet isolation; grep -rn 'no-deps|no_deps' lobes/ returns nothing

the single caller of compose_service_argv (line 231); TARGETS at line 92 is roles.ROLES + colleague-stack, so 'gateway' is not an addressable target; ROLE_SERVICE maps ten roles to services, gateway absent

gateway depends_on lists all four default core lanes unconditionally, annotated 'Start order only — the gateway ... must not block on backend health'; the muse/worker/associate lanes at 1245/1354/1602 carry a DIFFERENT, measured depends_on on embed+rerank service_healthy

a role-dropping shape already parks dropped services in the inert 'shape-dropped' profile and emits 'depends_on: !reset null' on the gateway — so the base edge is known-droppable, and its prose/goldens are the constraint on changing the base
the relay loop has no exception handling around either the upstream read1 or the client wfile.write, so a mid-stream failure skips CHUNK_TERMINATOR entirely and emits no terminal SSE frame

context comes from _served_context over the LOCAL .env plus the catalog native_max_model_len, and associate shares worker's role_hint (one checkpoint, two addresses) — which is also why the raw model id and 'worker' resolve to the local worker backend and 404 role_infeasible on the proxying box

the core-role peer probe asserts the peer's /v1/models lists served_name — unsatisfiable when the box forwards an alias — while the AUDIO peer probe already reads the peer's GET /capabilities and trusts roles[role].ready; the audio shape is the precedent to widen

part 4 names its own fix as resident-side (an old spark-colleague without the gateway key); part 3 has no defect localised in lobes and asks for a served-prompt-template check against the model card — neither is a lobes code change today
no acceptance transcript may be claimed without a live boot; the boxes in both issue reports are not being re-booted here, so every claim must be offline-testable or explicitly stay UNVALIDATED
